answer: Make reputation expire unless renewed: each identity keeps standing only by completing fresh tasks verified by two unrelated peers, and its whole history stays on one public terrace of records that cannot be copied to a new account. A sybil farm cannot simply mint identities and rest on velvet past success - every fake needs continuous new verified work, each copy paying the full cost again. A pigment trail of who verified whom lets peers spot a cluster sharing the same sponsors and revoke it at once.
